title: Sewer backup stop rules for a home
summary: A boundary card for toilets, drains, or floor traps pushing sewage back into a home during floods, power cuts, or municipal failures.
content: Core sequence: 1) Stop using toilets, sinks, washing machines, and showers connected to the affected drain. 2) Keep children, pets, food, shoes, and laundry away from wet contaminated areas. 3) Photograph damage from a dry safe edge and record the time, smell, rooms, and municipal report number. 4) Ventilate only if outdoor air is safe and do not mix cleaning chemicals while waiting for qualified repair or official guidance.
